unsupported_or_overstated_claims: The claim that the global catalog is unusable is not supported by row-level examples, search-impact measures, or evidence that manufacturer part numbers cannot provide stronger identity matching.
"The only safe solution" overstates the evidence and ignores bounded semantic candidate generation with engineering and availability confirmation.
The submission does not address cross-site stock, revision, unit-of-measure, qualification, reservation or criticality restrictions, or the freshness of the global MaintStar extract.
A master-data cleanup project is proposed without testing whether it is necessary before search or specifying scope, timing, safeguards, or success criteria.
strongest_alternative_interpretation: Inconsistent descriptions may reduce exact-match recall but do not establish that the catalog is unusable. Description normalization or semantic search could generate candidate matches, while manufacturer part number, revision, UOM, qualification and reservation checks determine whether a candidate is actually transferable. A bounded pilot could establish retrieval value without treating candidates as actionable substitutions.
single_most_valuable_next_improvement: Run a small, reversible pilot linking open requests to cross-site stock using normalized/semantic descriptions plus manufacturer part number, then validate revision, UOM, qualification, reservation/criticality and current availability against the freshest sources. Measure candidate precision, actionable-match rate and false-match risk before commissioning a full cleanup project.
